qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Urban tree plantations lower street temperatures by up to 3°C during peak summer afternoons. Through shade and evapotranspiration, roadside avenues act as natural air conditioners, reduce stormwater runoff during monsoon cloudbursts, and shelter urban birds.' — Question: By how much can urban tree plantations reduce street temperatures during peak summer afternoons?
qh: गद्यांश के अनुसार शहरी वृक्षारोपण गर्मियों की दोपहर में सड़क के तापमान को कितना कम कर सकता है?
e: The passage states trees 'lower street temperatures by up to 3°C'.

qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Urban tree plantations lower street temperatures by up to 3°C during peak summer afternoons. Through shade and evapotranspiration, roadside avenues act as natural air conditioners, reduce stormwater runoff during monsoon cloudbursts, and shelter urban birds.' — Question: Besides cooling streets, what two additional benefits of roadside avenues are mentioned?
qh: सड़कों को ठंडा करने के अलावा सड़क किनारे पेड़ों के कौन-से दो अतिरिक्त लाभ गद्यांश में बताए गए हैं?
oe: Increasing traffic noise and concrete cracks
Reducing monsoon stormwater runoff and sheltering urban birds
oh: मानसूनी जलभराव/अपवाह को कम करना और शहरी पक्षियों को आश्रय देना
e: They 'reduce stormwater runoff during monsoon cloudbursts, and shelter urban birds'.

qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Urban tree plantations lower street temperatures by up to 3°C during peak summer afternoons. Through shade and evapotranspiration, roadside avenues act as natural air conditioners, reduce stormwater runoff during monsoon cloudbursts, and shelter urban birds.' — Question: Which word in the passage refers to 'sudden heavy rainfall'?
qh: गद्यांश में 'अचानक मूसलाधार वर्षा' के लिए कौन-सा शब्द प्रयोग हुआ है?
e: 'Cloudbursts' denotes sudden, intense rainfall.

qe: Cloze: 'To prevent typing fatigue, adjust your chair (A) _____ and keep the monitor at (B) _____ level.' Choose the best pair:
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'To prevent typing fatigue, adjust your chair (A) _____ and keep the monitor at (B) _____ level.'
e: Ergonomics requires proper chair height and eye-level monitor placement.

qe: Choose the correct Question Tag: 'You have completed the Excel sheet, ______?'
qh: सही Question Tag चुनें: 'You have completed the Excel sheet, ______?'
e: Positive auxiliary 'have' takes negative tag 'haven't you?'.

qe: Change to Passive Voice: 'The principal gave him a merit certificate.'
qh: Passive Voice में बदलें: 'The principal gave him a merit certificate.'
oe: He was given a merit certificate by the principal.
A merit certificate was giving him.
He has been given a merit certificate.
He is given a merit certificate by the principal.
oh: He was given a merit certificate by the principal.
A merit certificate was giving him.
He has been given a merit certificate.
He is given a merit certificate by the principal.
e: Simple Past Active ('gave') → Simple Past Passive ('was given').

qe: Convert to Indirect Speech: Ritu said, "I will submit the assignment tomorrow."
qh: Indirect Speech में बदलें: Ritu said, "I will submit the assignment tomorrow."
oe: Ritu said that she will submit the assignment tomorrow.
Ritu told she had submitted next day.
Ritu said that I would submit tomorrow.
Ritu said that she would submit the assignment the next day.
oh: Ritu said that she will submit the assignment tomorrow.
Ritu told she had submitted next day.
Ritu said that I would submit tomorrow.
Ritu said that she would submit the assignment the next day.
e: 'will' → 'would' and 'tomorrow' → 'the next day'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He congratulated his friend ______ winning the scholarship.'
qh: सही Preposition भरें: 'He congratulated his friend ______ winning the scholarship.'
e: Standard usage is 'congratulate someone on' something (not 'for').

qe: Fill in the blank: 'Ten kilometres ______ a long distance to walk daily.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Ten kilometres ______ a long distance to walk daily.'
e: Plural expressions denoting a single distance, amount, or time unit take a singular verb ('is').

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'PROHIBIT':
qh: 'PROHIBIT' (निषेध/रोक लगाना) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Prohibit = formally forbid or ban.

qe: Choose the ANTONYM of 'HOSTILITY':
qh: 'HOSTILITY' (शत्रुता) का विलोम चुनें:
e: Hostility = antagonism; Friendliness / Goodwill = warmth and cooperation.

qe: One-word substitution for: 'A life history of a person written by himself/herself'
qh: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'A life history of a person written by himself/herself'
e: Autobiography = self-written life story; Biography = written by someone else.

qe: Choose the word with the CORRECT spelling for 'a government agency division or office section':
qh: 'नौकरशाही' (office/government administration system) के लिए सही वर्तनी चुनें:
e: Correct spelling: B-U-R-E-A-U-C-R-A-C-Y.

qe: What does the idiom 'To smell a rat' mean?
qh: 'To smell a rat' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
oe: To suspect trickery, dishonesty, or foul play
oh: किसी गड़बड़ी, धोखे या षड्यंत्र का संदेह होना
सब पर आँख मूँदकर भरोसा करना
e: 'Smell a rat' means sensing something suspicious or deceitful.

qe: What does the idiom 'Under the weather' mean?
qh: 'Under the weather' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
oh: थोड़ा अस्वस्थ या बीमार महसूस करना
e: 'Under the weather' means feeling mildly ill or low in energy.

qe: Arrange to form a meaningful sentence: 1. accuracy  2. speed  3. both  4. require  5. clerical jobs
qh: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने हेतु सही क्रम चुनें: 1. accuracy  2. speed  3. both  4. require  5. clerical jobs
e: 'Clerical jobs require both speed and accuracy.'

qe: Spot the error: 'He is one of the best (A) / clerk in our (B) / district office. (C) / No error (D)'
qh: त्रुटि वाला भाग पहचानें: 'He is one of the best (A) / clerk in our (B) / district office. (C) / No error (D)'
e: 'One of the + superlative' is always followed by a plural noun ('clerks').

qe: Improve the quoted part: 'No sooner did the bell rang "than" the students ran out.' (Fix 'rang')
qh: वाक्य में क्रिया सुधारें: 'No sooner did the bell "rang" than the students ran out.'
e: After auxiliary 'did', always use base verb V₁ ('ring'), never 'rang'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'You ______ not worry; all documents are verified.' (Absence of necessity)
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'You ______ not worry; all documents are verified.'
e: 'Need not' expresses absence of necessity ('You need not worry').

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'ZENITH' (highest point):
qh: 'ZENITH' (शिखर/चरम बिंदु) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Zenith = peak/pinnacle; its exact antonym is Nadir.

qe: Choose the ANTONYM of 'TRANSIENT' (short-lived):
qh: 'TRANSIENT' (क्षणभंगुर/अस्थायी) का विलोम चुनें:
e: Transient = temporary/brief; Permanent = lasting forever.

qe: Select the sentence in Past Perfect Continuous tense:
qh: Past Perfect Continuous Tense वाला वाक्य चुनें:
oe: They had been working here for three years before transfer.
oh: They had been working here for three years before transfer.
e: 'had been + V₁-ing' expresses Past Perfect Continuous.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'She prefers tea ______ coffee.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'She prefers tea ______ coffee.'
e: 'Prefer' takes 'to' when comparing two things.

qe: Choose the correct collocation with 'mistake':
qh: 'mistake' के साथ सही अंग्रेजी कोलोकेशन चुनें:
e: Standard English uses 'make a mistake' (not 'do a mistake').

qe: One-word substitution for: 'A person who knows many languages'
qh: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'A person who knows many languages'
e: Polyglot = fluent in multiple languages.

qe: Choose the word with the CORRECT spelling for 'a fixed schedule/list of items to discuss at a meeting':
qh: 'कार्यसूची' अर्थ वाले अंग्रेजी शब्द की सही वर्तनी चुनें:
e: Correct spelling: A-G-E-N-D-A.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The cat jumped ______ the table.' (Motion onto)
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The cat jumped ______ the table.' (सतह पर गति हेतु)
e: 'Onto / upon' expresses movement toward a higher surface.

qe: Identify the correct Indirect Speech: The clerk asked, "Where is the register?"
qh: Indirect Speech में बदलें: The clerk asked, "Where is the register?"
oe: The clerk told where the register is.
The clerk asked where was the register.
The clerk asked where the register was.
The clerk asked that where is register.
oh: The clerk told where the register is.
The clerk asked where was the register.
The clerk asked where the register was.
The clerk asked that where is register.
e: In indirect wh-questions, word order becomes declarative (subject before verb) and 'is' backshifts to 'was'.

qe: What is the meaning of the idiom 'To leave no stone unturned'?
qh: 'To leave no stone unturned' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
oe: To make every possible effort to achieve a goal
To drop stones in a river
oh: लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने के लिए हर संभव प्रयास करना
आधे रास्ते में हार मान लेना
e: 'Leave no stone unturned' means trying every conceivable method.

qe: Fill in the blank: '______ honesty is the best policy.' (Article)
qh: सही Article चुनें: '______ honesty is the best policy.'
e: Abstract nouns used in a general sense ('honesty') take no article.
